LanguageData.USAC_HeavyMachineGunMounted.label: Foxhound GPMG
LanguageData.USAC_HeavyMachineGunMounted.description: A general-purpose heavy machine gun built on a lightweight composite frame, found on weapon platforms and fixed defenses everywhere. Long ago, before the war choked off the materials it needed, it was a highly successful replacement for the M2 heavy machine gun.
